plugin.desc.filesystem: Local file and directory access for scanning project structure, reading and writing files.
plugin.desc.document: Local document processing for Word, PDF, Markdown, PPT parsing and generation.
plugin.desc.code: Code search and editing for listing files, searching text and precise code modifications.
plugin.desc.shell: Terminal command execution for build, test, install and more.
plugin.desc.git: Git version control for status, diff and commits.
plugin.desc.web: Web access for fetching URLs, extracting content and rendering dynamic pages.
plugin.desc.preview: Preview and visual-debug capability for screenshots, console errors and rendered local HTML or URL checks.
plugin.desc.desktop: Read-only desktop observation for windows, processes, and confirmed screenshot evidence. It does not click, type, or control windows.
plugin.desc.spreadsheet: Local spreadsheet reading for previewing XLSX, CSV, and TSV workbook content.
plugin.desc.attachment: Conversation attachment context for reading user-uploaded images and files.
plugin.desc.memory: User memory context for saving and recalling long-term preferences and working habits.
plugin.desc.mcp_blender: Modeling and scene capabilities dynamically discovered from the Blender MCP service.

contract.write_rule: Choose the execution strategy yourself. Do not report completion unless the target artifact or external state has actually been created or updated. Tools are implementation means.
contract.verify_rule: Choose an appropriate verification method when feasible. The runtime records evidence but does not choose the strategy for you.
contract.summary_rule: Base the final summary on actual tool events, and state incomplete or unverified work truthfully.

planner.intro:
You are generating an execution plan for YuntaoCode. Output strict JSON only, no Markdown, no explanation, do not execute the task.
Current project directory: {workspace_path}
planner.focus_coding: The current task contract may involve code changes. Decide from the user goal whether to read files, edit code, run checks, or state risks; treat these notes as advisory, not a fixed route.
planner.focus_paper: The current task contract may involve research or academic writing. Decide from the user goal which materials, fact boundaries, quality checks, and output steps are needed; treat these notes as advisory, not a fixed route.
planner.focus_general: Plan the needed context, tool actions, deliverables, and verification evidence from the current task goal. The plan is audit and collaboration context, not a fixed route.
planner.json_format:
JSON format: {"title":"short title","steps":[{"title":"step title","description":"what and why","tool_hint":"possible local tools or operations"}]}
Keep steps between 3 and 7, each step must be executable and verifiable.
